AGRICULTURE — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Properties of soil? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Properties of soil.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of soil.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Properties of soil.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Properties of soil.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Land Preparation? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Land Preparation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Land Preparation.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Land Preparation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Land Preparation.

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agricultural Land? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agricultural Land.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Agricultural Land.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agricultural Land.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agricultural Land.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying General Crop Harvesting? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on General Crop Harvesting.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for General Crop Harvesting.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about General Crop Harvesting.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to General Crop Harvesting.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Weed control? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Weed control.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Weed control.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Weed control.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Weed control.

9. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Breeds of Livestock? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Breeds of Livestock.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Breeds of Livestock.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Breeds of Livestock.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Breeds of Livestock.

11. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.

13. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

14. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B.

16. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Only water vapour

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Field Management Practices? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Field Management Practices.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Field Management Practices.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Field Management Practices.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Field Management Practices.

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safe Handling of Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safe Handling of Animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Safe Handling of Animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safe Handling of Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safe Handling of Animals.

19. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

20. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Selected Crop? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Selected Crop.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Selected Crop.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Selected Crop.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Selected Crop.

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Land Preparation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Field Management Practices and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Growing Selected Crop and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Crop Protection: Weed control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain General Crop Harvesting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
